walls.note: Front: the grinning boy, hands on hips, and the faceted column with its plaque (Anefo 918-6782 and 932-2062; FaceMePLS 6944003989).

items.where: bronze street urchin about 1.4 m: cap pushed back, grin, hands on hips, rolled sleeves, belted shorts, wrinkled knee socks, legs apart
items.how: builder: figure kit pose (arms back and out, forearms in to the hips), cap hat, thickened thighs for the shorts, waistband, sock bunches, cuff balls; no face or fabric creasing

items.where: square column of rough-faceted granite on a base slab, 1.25 m to the bronze foot plate
items.how: builder: base slab, two courses with a step and a cap slab; the diamond faceting of the faces is not carved

items.where: small bronze plaque on the front of the column
items.how: builder: bronze plate box; its text is unreadable in every available photo, so none is invented

walls.note: Side: boy in profile on the column (panorama 01351).
Back: column and the boy from behind; not photographed.

sources.name: Joost Evers / Anefo, Het Lieverdje op het Spui (918-6782)
